// why: A `.local.env` beside a `package.json` with no `project.json` next to it. nx makes a project of such a manifest under `workspaces`, and this gate counts it a place either way. It is the last place of the walk, so a rule that stops one place short, or reads `project.json` alone, passes it.

addRoots.name: package.json
addRoots.reason: The package manager reads a manifest by this name in every package of the workspace.
